title: Dashboards: config change health + rollback visibility; alerts for stuck applies
author: Aisha Bello
release_notes: Adds Grafana dashboards to correlate Optimize config version changes with latency/error/cost, and introduces Prometheus alerting for stuck/failed config applies with deep links (when present) to rollback/history views.
body:
Title: Dashboards: config change health + rollback visibility; alerts for stuck applies

Context
As part of Safe apply + rollback, SRE/On-call needs a single place to answer: (1) did a config version change occur, (2) where did it apply (scope/cluster/region), (3) did latency/error/cost move, and (4) is apply/rollback stuck.

This PR adds two Grafana dashboards and a small alerting bundle in observability-pack to correlate Optimize config version events with core golden signals. It also standardizes how we thread correlation_id / apply_id through panels and annotations.

What’s in this PR
- New Grafana dashboard: "Optimize Config Change Health" (overview + per-scope drilldown)
  - Timeline annotations for config apply/rollback events
  - p50/p95/p99 latency and error rate overlays around a selected change window
  - Saturation panels (GPU queue depth / scheduler backlog where available)
  - Apply/rollback success rate + apply duration distribution
  - Optional filters: environment, region, cluster, tenant_id, deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated/private), scope_key
- New Grafana dashboard: "Optimize Config Change Explorer" (forensics)
  - Table panel of recent changes (last 24h/7d) backed by metrics + labels
  - Deep-link helpers (Console history/compare + incident-bot links) when correlation_id is present
  - Cost panels: tokens/sec vs $/1M tokens (when metering series exists) and cache hit rate overlays
- Alert rules
  - OptimizeConfigApplyStuck: firing when an apply is "in_progress" beyond threshold (default 15m) for a given scope_key
  - OptimizeConfigApplyErrorSpike: elevated apply failures in 10m window (intended to page on-call only when persistent)
  - OptimizeConfigRollbackFailed: rollback attempt fails and does not recover within 5m
- Recording rules
  - Lightweight rollup series for apply duration and failure ratios to avoid expensive dashboards queries

Implementation details
- Dashboards are defined in jsonnet and published via the existing mixin pipeline.
- Annotation source uses optimize_control_plane_config_change_events_total (counter) with labels: action={apply|rollback}, outcome={success|failure|attempted}, scope_key, tenant_id (if set), region, cluster, correlation_id.
- Panel queries intentionally avoid high-cardinality joins on correlation_id; correlation_id is used for deep links and table display only.
- Alerts primarily keyed by scope_key + environment + region; tenant_id is included only for dedicated/private where cardinality is bounded.

Screenshots / Panel list (high level)
- Overview row: "Applies started", "Applies succeeded", "Rollbacks started", "Rollbacks succeeded", "Apply p95 duration"
- Health row: "p95 latency", "Error rate", "GPU saturation", "Scheduler backlog"
- Cost row: "$ / 1M tokens", "Cache hit rate", "Batch size (effective)" (if emitted)
- Explorer: Recent changes table + per-change linkouts

Why now
We saw multiple incidents where a config change correlated with a latency spike, but the timeline correlation required hopping between 3+ dashboards and reading deploy-bot logs. This puts change events and SLO signals side-by-side and adds a clear page when apply gets stuck mid-propagation.

Testing / Validation
- Rendered dashboards in staging Grafana and verified variable wiring for hosted + dedicated clusters
- Verified annotations show up when replaying synthetic config change events in dev
- Unit: jsonnet compilation in CI, promtool rule validation

Rollout
- Dashboards are safe to deploy immediately (no runtime impact)
- Alerts are default-disabled in prod via "alerts_enabled" toggle; will be enabled per environment after SRE sign-off

Follow-ups (out of scope)
- Add quality/evals gate overlay once those metrics are exported in the same label space
- Add a panel for "KV cache invalidations" once runtime exports the counter consistently

References
- Linear: ENG-4828 (metrics/alerts), ENG-4823 (rollback endpoint)
- Related PRs: redwood/pr-10479 (propagation status), redwood/pr-10502 (rollback notifications)

Checklist
- [x] Dashboards compile in CI
- [x] promtool check passes
- [x] Variables default to low-cardinality label sets
- [x] Alert routes documented in README

Commits
1) mixin: add optimize config change dashboard scaffolding
2) dashboards: add overview panels + annotation layer
3) dashboards: add explorer table + linkout templating
4) rules: add recording rules for apply duration + failure ratios
5) alerts: add stuck apply + rollback failed alerts (gated)
6) docs: add runbook notes for interpreting panels and alert triage

Files changed (high level)
- grafana/dashboards/optimize_config_change_health.jsonnet
- grafana/dashboards/optimize_config_change_explorer.jsonnet
- grafana/dashboards/_variables_optimize_config_changes.libsonnet
- prometheus/rules/optimize_config_changes_recording.rules.yaml
- prometheus/alerts/optimize_config_changes.alerts.yaml
- mixins/optimize/config_changes/mixin.libsonnet
- mixins/optimize/config_changes/README.md
- scripts/ci/validate-mixins.sh

Review conversation (abridged)
- Allison Grant: "Please avoid correlation_id in time-series group_by; Grafana will melt on hosted." Aisha: "Agreed; removed from grouping. Keeping correlation_id only in table and as a dashboard link var." (updated)
- Logan Wright: "Stuck threshold should be tier-dependent; can we make it configurable?" Aisha: "Added alert param apply_stuck_threshold_minutes with defaults; documented override in values." (updated)
- Caleb Johnson: "Queries should use sum by(scope_key, region, env) and rely on recording rules for ratios." Aisha: "Moved most ratio panels to recording rules; left ad-hoc panel only in Explorer." (updated)
- Neha Kapoor: "Alert should page only after 2 evaluation windows and include a link to rollback UI." Aisha: "Added for: 10m and included annotations for deep link label if present; routing remains disabled by default." (updated)
